comments.author: Chronic
comments.body: That 658 cargo is what it comes out from ticket with. What is the effective range and full range of this ship as well as the required sailors?

comments.author: V\
comments.body:
Consider the crew is 92/gun 70 and cargo 658 = 820(total capacity) the ship range can be change between 75% (which means less cargo ) or 125% which means max cargo
so 820 = 100% 820x125/100 = 1025 is a max full range and 820x75/100 =615.And for effective range would be 820x120/100 = 984 and for less cargo 820x80/100= 656.

So the Full range would be 615 -1025
and effective range would be 656-984
for a max cargo with full range and effective range it would be

Range 1025 - 46 - 35 = 944
Effective Range 984 - 46 - 33 = 903
